title: PRs pill: a dropdown of projects with open PRs, their PRs, and a detail card per PR
summary: The top-bar review badge is replaced by a PRs pill with the total of open pull requests; it opens a dropdown of projects, their pull requests (review requests first) and a detail card with an Open on GitHub link.

deferred.what: For a project whose git remote is not on GitHub, gh answers with a message containing 'gh auth login', which the runner maps to NotAuthenticated; the PRs pill then shows a lasting 'Could not load: Not authenticated ... Try again' row for it instead of leaving it out, and the watchdog stops its whole cycle there, so later projects lose their review marks.
deferred.why: Pre-existing Rust outside the PRs pill story's seam, and the fix also changes the watchdog.
